scene: On the pirate sloop's deck in bright sun, the Young Sailor (thin young man of nineteen, straight black hair, a first wispy mustache, faded red-and-white striped shirt, canvas trousers rolled to the knee, barefoot) is held by both arms between the Captain (black tricorn, full brown beard, burgundy long coat) and the Quartermaster (dark-brown wavy hair, light stubble, white shirt, dark-brown waistcoat), mouth wide open in disbelief, eyes huge. The Quartermaster holds his ledger and looks at him with a tired, knowing face. Behind them, the small flour sloop the sailor came from sails away, with an old gray-bearded sailor at her rail slowly waving. Tension: robbed once, kept the second time.

On a sunny tropical beach, the Young Sailor stands ankle-deep in the surf holding a small wooden water barrel against his chest, staring sideways at a dark, inviting wall of jungle trees just a few steps away, sweating and torn. Behind him at the water's edge, the pirate rowing boat waits with Tom (navy waistcoat, no hat) at the oars, half-smiling and pretending not to notice, while the Quartermaster stands in the boat checking his ledger. Tension: one chance to run, and every reason to fear it.
